statement.conclusion: The source states f(bar x_N)-f(x*) <= DL/sqrt(N+1). Boundary use must respect the recorded issue; do not use this as a contradiction to g-convex lower bounds.
statement.objects_and_definitions: For unit v in T_yM, B_{y,v}(x)=lim_{t->infty}[d(Exp_y(-tv),x)-t]; for arbitrary v multiply by ||v|| (B_{y,0}=0). h-convexity means for each y there exists v with f(x)-f(y)>=B_{y,v}(x) for all x in M.
